title: DocuLink Financial Statement Values v1
description: Financial numbers, percentages, dates, and structured financial-statement notes detected from text geometry. Coordinates use normalized displayed-page, top-left-origin 0–1 space.

notes.description: Canonical document-level footnote catalogue. One item is emitted per normalized note identifier; continuation headings are occurrences of the same note, never duplicate catalogue entries.

noteReferences.description: Narrative citations linked to the canonical note catalogue. A citation naming several notes produces one reference per identifier, sharing the source text and bounds.

normalizedValue.description: Exact canonical decimal for numbers/percentages, or ISO-like value for unambiguous dates. Never a binary float.

magnitude.description: Multiplier expressed by a modifier attached directly to this number. normalizedValue already includes this multiplier.

segments.description: Physical click regions when a logical value wraps across lines or pages. bounds remains the first segment; each segment creates the full logical value while drawing only its own rectangle.

NoteHeader.description: One physical occurrence of a complete note heading. A continuation occurrence remains attached to the canonical note rather than creating a second catalogue item.

segments.description: Physical lines of a wrapped heading, in reading order. bounds encloses all segments on the page.

Note.description: One canonical financial-statement note, keyed by a normalized integer, decimal or Roman-numeral identifier.

description.description: Canonical heading description without the Note identifier or continuation marker. Empty only when no heading supplies one.

NoteReference.description: One note identifier cited by narrative text and linked to its canonical catalogue entry.

description.description: Canonical description resolved from the note catalogue.

text.description: The complete citation as printed, including an explicit description when present.

descriptionPresent.description: True when the printed citation supplied a description; false when description was resolved only from the catalogue.

sourceDescription.description: Description printed in the citation. Present only when descriptionPresent is true.

NoiseValue.description: A text span classified as non-linkable diagnostic noise. Most entries are recognized values later refused by evidence, while structured note headings and references are captured as complete text spans. Noise is never a click target.

reason.description: The classification group for this noise span. A new group is added here before it is implemented.

noise.description: Text spans this page classified as noise. Absent or empty when nothing was refused or classified. These are diagnostics, not values — no consumer may treat them as linkable.
